chapter.heading: Ezekiel 28
Prophecy Against the Prince of Tyre
chapter.v: 28 The word of the Lord came to me:
though you make your heart like the heart of a god—
no secret is hidden from you;
into your treasuries;
your heart has become proud in your wealth—
like the heart of a god,
your splendor.
in the heart of the seas.
in the hands of those who slay you?
for I have spoken, declares the Lord God .”
Moreover, the word of the Lord came to me:
full of wisdom andperfect in beauty.
they were prepared.
in the midst of the stones of fire you walked.
till unrighteousness was found in you.
from the midst of the stones of fire.
to feast their eyes on you.
in the sight of all who saw you.
and shall be no more forever.”
The word of the Lord came to me:
prophesy against her
manifest my holiness in her;
Then they will know that I am the Lord .
who have treated them with contempt. Then they will know that I am the Lord God .
then they shall dwell in their own land that I gave to my servant Jacob.
Then they will know that I am the Lord their God.”
